basic_details.job_title: OAV Bapanpalli Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 5 Assistant Cook, Warden and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya Bapanpalli, Padia (Malkangiri district) is filling 5 support staff posts in its Boys' Hostel: Warden (1), Chowkidar-cum-sweeper (1), Head Cook (1) and Assistant Cook (2). Applications must be sent by Speed Post only to the Principal, Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya Bapanpalli, At: Bapanpalli, PO: Padia, Dist: Malkangiri, PIN: 764047, State: Odisha, by 26 November 2026. The school works under the Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya Sangathan, Department of School and Mass Education, Govt. of Odisha, and the advertisement is issued by order of the Collector and DM cum Chairman, OAV Bapanp

qualification.details: Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Download the application form for Warden / Head Cook / Asst. Cook / Chowkidar-cum-sweeper in Boys' Hostel of Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya Bapanpalli, Padia, Malkangiri. Fill the application form in capital letters and write the post applied for. Fix a passport size photograph in the box on the form. Enclose self-attested photocopies of the documents listed under Enclosures below, and sign the declaration. Send the application through Speed Post only to: Principal, Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya Bapanpalli, At: Bapanpalli, PO: Padia, Dist: Malkangiri, PIN: 764047, State: Odisha. Make sure the application is sent by 26 November 2026; the notice states that application forms received after the due date shall be summarily rejected. An application form submitted by any mode other than Speed Post will not be entertained, and the authority will not be responsible for postal delay. The notice does not mention what to write on the envelope.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The application form lists these self-attested photocopies to be enclosed: HSC Certificate HSC Mark Sheet +2 Certificate +2 Mark Sheet BA/BSc Certificate BA/BSc Mark Sheet Caste Certificate Aadhar Card Residence Certificate Certificate of Experience in Hostel Management 2 nos Passport size photographs

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: According to the staff position table in the notice, the Warden, Chowkidar-cum-sweeper, Head Cook and Assistant Cook are to be selected by the District as per Govt. guideline. Head Cook: the committee staff conduct physical cooking of some items and evaluate the deliciousness, the time taken to prepare the dishes and the hygienic condition of cooking, and select the best. Warden: preference is given to the local candidate, preferably from the block area, and then from the adjacent block of the district. Head Cook: candidates trained in cookery get preference and due weightage.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in OAV Bapanpalli Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 vacancies in the Boys' Hostel: Warden 1, Chowkidar-cum-sweeper 1, Head Cook 1 and Assistant Cook 2.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent by Speed Post to the Principal of OAV Bapanpalli by 26 November 2026; forms received after the due date shall be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Warden post?
faq.answer: The Warden needs a B.A/B.Sc from any recognized University and at least 02 years of experience in hostel management.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Chowkidar-cum-sweeper?
faq.answer: The Chowkidar-cum-sweeper must have passed the HSC Examination; the post is for male candidates aged 21 to 32 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for each post?
faq.answer: As on the date of advertisement, the age limit is 30-60 years for Warden, 21-32 years for Chowkidar-cum-sweeper, 30-40 years for Head Cook and 21-32 years for Assistant Cook.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of OAV Bapanpalli hostel staff?
faq.answer: The monthly remuneration is Rs. 21,175 for Warden, Rs. 7,500 for Chowkidar-cum-sweeper, Rs. 9,000 for Head Cook and Rs. 6,750 for Assistant Cook, each including the EPF share of Employee & Employer.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for OAV Bapanpalli Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Download the form from https://malkangiri.odisha.gov.in or https://oav.edu.in/OAVBAP, fill it in capital letters, attach self-attested documents and send it by Speed Post only to Principal, Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya Bapanpalli, At: Bapanpalli, PO: Padia, Dist: Malkangiri, PIN: 764047, State: Odisha.

faq.question: Q8. How is the Head Cook selected?
faq.answer: The committee conducts physical cooking of some items, evaluates taste, preparation time and hygiene, and selects the best; candidates trained in cookery get preference and due weightage.

faq.question: Q9. Do the Warden and cooks have to stay in the hostel?
faq.answer: Yes, the Warden, Head Cook and Assistant Cook have to stay in the hostel 24x7.

faq.question: Q10. Can retired teachers apply for the Warden post?
faq.answer: Retired teachers, if willing and physically and mentally sound within the age limit of 62 years as on the date of engagement, may be engaged as Warden.
